findings.evidence:
pdp-flood-m-js-full.png, print section at approx y=2570–2840: the cream mat shows the cactus-garden photo with the caption "גן קקטוסים, בשקיעה" and NOTHING under it. mirrors/pdp-flood/index.html ens-pdp-print figcaption contains only

vote.why:
The render is described correctly but read wrongly: the photograph is public domain, so no credit is owed, and the empty credit is a deliberate, documented state — not a missing element.

What I measured:

1. The render. Cropped brief/side-pages/pdp3/verify/pdp-flood-m-js-full.png (390x4498) at y=2540-2880: cream mat, a cactus-garden-at-sunset photo, caption "גן קקטוסים, בשקיעה", nothing under it. So the visual claim is accurate.

2. Which photo it is. theme/sections/elmsnest-s-pdp-print.liquid, the גינה branch (lines 56-68), sets ens_file = 'ens-pdp-print-garden.jpg', ens_w = 1200, ens_h = 801, ens_cap default 'גן קקטוסים, בשקיעה'. The shipped file /home/user/ElmsNest/theme/assets/ens-pdp-print-garden.jpg is 1200x801. That matches exactly one manifest row: brief/side-pages/pdp3/images/manifest.jsonl id wm_54cd152739, "Cholla Cactus Garden Path at Sunset", author "Joshua Tree National Park", **"license": "Public domain"**.

3. What the round says the credit should be. brief/side-pages/pdp3/images/CHOSEN.md line 11 lists that same crop with licence "Public domain" and, in the "credit line" column, the literal value **none** — while every CC BY / BY-SA row in the same table carries a "צילום: ..." string. brief/side-pages/pdp3/BRIEF.md §4: commercial-safe licences are "CC0, public domain, CC BY, CC BY-SA" and "**CC BY / CC BY-SA photographs carry a credit**" — public domain is explicitly not in that set.

4. The section encodes this on purpose, not by omission. The garden branch alone resolves ens_credit to '' when unset (lines 66-67), and its schema field is the only one of the four with no default and with an explanatory info string: { "type": "text", "id": "credit_garden", "label": "קרדיט", "info": "התצלום נחלת הכלל ואינו חייב קרדיט." } — "the photograph is public domain and requires no credit." The other three (credit_path / credit_wall / credit_balcony) all default to a filled credit line, which is why path/rope/wall show two credits in verify.json and flood shows one. So verify.json's asymmetry is the licence asymmetry, not a dropped field.

5. The same rule is already applied elsewhere on the same page. SPEC.md §2 line 61 records `credit_sun` as *(empty — CC0 needs none)* for the CC0 Carol M Highsmith sun tile. The proposed fix — "make the credit line mandatory in the section schema so a missing credit fails the build" — would fail the build on that CC0 tile too, and would force a fabricated attribution onto a US National Park Service public-domain work.

Also checked: the figcaption markup does emit ens-pdp-print__credit whenever the credit is non-empty ({%- if ens_credit_html != '' -%}), so the element is not absent from the template, only unrendered for this one licence.

One genuine but separate doc nit, which does not save the finding: SPEC.md §3's table still lists the גינה slot as ens-pdp-print-garden.jpg 1000x667 / wm_faf95922bd / Basile Morin CC BY-SA 4.0 with caption "ספסל בגינה, לפנות ערב", whereas the shipped asset is the 1200x801 public-domain Cholla crop with caption "גן קקטוסים, בשקיעה". That is stale SPEC prose about a swap that CHOSEN.md and the Liquid both record consistently — a table-refresh chore, not a missing credit, and certainly not a blocker.
vote.scope: In this round's contract (the print section, §3), but factually wrong: the finding treats a public-domain photograph as an uncredited CC-licensed one. BRIEF §4, CHOSEN.md and the section schema all record "no credit" as the correct state for this slot, and the proposed "credit mandatory or fail the build" rule would also break the CC0 sun tile that SPEC §2 deliberately leaves uncredited.

findings.title: The "שמש של אוגוסט" photo is uncredited on all five pages, next to a credited sibling
findings.evidence: mirrors/*/index.html ens-pdp-weather: the rain tile figcaption has "צילום: h080 (CC BY-SA 2.0)" (or jenny downing on wall), the sun tile (5209afdeb1909a741a71848de3bdb47f.jpg, alt "בוגנוויליה על קיר, בשמש של צהריים") has a caption and no credit. findings.fix: Add the credit to the bougainvillea photo. If it is your own photo, say so explicitly ("צילום: ElmsNest") — an uncredited photo sitting beside a credited one reads as a missing licence, not as ownership.

vote.why:
The observation is factually accurate but is not a defect — it is exactly what the round's contract and licence record require, and the proposed fix would introduce a false statement.

What I measured:

1. The render, all five mirrors (/home/user/ElmsNest/brief/side-pages/pdp3/verify/mirrors/*/index.html, ens-pdp-weather). Parsed both figures per page. Rain tile always carries a `<span class="ens-pdp-weather__credit">` — "צילום: h080 (CC BY-SA 2.0)" on path/rope/deck/flood (solar → panel) and "צילום: jenny downing (CC BY 2.0)" on wall (mains → stem). Sun tile (src a/5209afdeb1909a741a71848de3bdb47f.jpg, alt "בוגנוויליה על קיר, בשמש של צהריים") has the caption but no credit span, on all five. Same in /home/user/ElmsNest/brief/side-pages/pdp3/verify/verify.json — every page's pdpSections weather text ends "...שמש של אוגוסט. בוגנוויליה על קיר, בשמש של צהריים" with no credit, and pdpCopy.credits lists only the rain credit plus the print credit. Cropped pdp-path-m-js-full.png y=1900–2180 and read it: the pair sits side by side under "בחוץ, כל השנה", bougainvillea-on-wall left, wet solar panel right, exactly as described. So the evidence is not wrong; the reading of it is.

2. The licence. /home/user/ElmsNest/brief/side-pages/pdp3/images/manifest.jsonl line 242: ov_7379ba54-775e-4044-b839-56ce83f7deb1, "Bougainvillea explode color outside this", Carol M Highsmith, license "CC CC0 1.0", rawpixel page 582428. SHORTLIST.md line 37 and line 69 both record this asset's credit line as literally "none — CC0 so no credit". CHOSEN.md line 7 maps it to ens-pdp-sun-wall.jpg (1200×900). The srcset in the mirror caps at 1200w and 5209afdeb… is that 1200w candidate, so the deployed sun tile is that CC0 file. The other tile's file is CC BY-SA 2.0, which is why it is credited. The asymmetry the critique sees is the licence asymmetry, rendered correctly.

3. The rule. /home/user/ElmsNest/brief/side-pages/pdp3/BRIEF.md §4 lines 58-61: "CC BY / BY-SA photographs carry a credit («צילום: Name (CC BY 2.0)») as an 11–12 px muted caption inside the section — never omitted; CC0/PDM need none." The page follows this verbatim. SPEC.md §2 line 61 records the setting explicitly: credit_sun = "(empty — CC0 needs none)", and ruling R7 (SPEC §1) names the sun tile as "the white wall in noon sun (CC0)". elmsnest-s-pdp-weather.liquid backs this with an asymmetry that is deliberate and defensive: the two rain slots hard-code a fallback credit ("while the theme asset is in use its credit cannot be emptied" — if the owner blanks credit_rain_solar the licensed credit reappears), while credit_sun has no fallback and its schema info reads "התצלום הוא CC0 ואינו חייב קרדיט". So the missing credit is a written ruling, not an oversight.

4. The proposed fix is worse than the state it fixes. It asks for "צילום: ElmsNest" as the alternative. The photograph is Carol M Highsmith's, sourced from rawpixel — printing "צילום: ElmsNest" on it would be a false ownership claim on someone else's work, which BRIEF.md §3 / pdp3 BRIEF §4 honesty rules forbid outright. The only truthful credit available would be "צילום: Carol M Highsmith (CC CC0 1.0)", which CC0 does not require and which SPEC §2 deliberately left empty.

The one residual point that is not refuted: a reader cannot tell from the page alone that the uncredited photo is CC0 rather than unlicensed. That is a cosmetic/consistency preference, not a blocker, and it re-opens a ruling (SPEC §2 credit_sun, BRIEF §4 "CC0/PDM need none") whose reasoning is factually correct — the licence genuinely requires no attribution.
vote.scope: Out of scope as a blocker: it re-opens a recorded ruling (pdp3 SPEC.md §1 R7 and §2 credit_sun = empty; pdp3 BRIEF.md §4 "CC0/PDM need none") whose own reasoning is factually correct — the sun photo is CC0 1.0 (Carol M Highsmith, manifest.jsonl:242, SHORTLIST.md:37 credit "none"), so no attribution is owed. At most a voluntary cosmetic courtesy credit ("צילום: Carol M Highsmith (CC CC0 1.0)") could be added; the fix as proposed ("צילום: ElmsNest") is a false ownership claim and must not be applied.

findings.title: The same two weather photos appear on all five products, and the same print photo on two of them

vote.why: The raw pixels are right, the reading is not. Measured: I cropped pdp-path-m-js-full.png y2900-3600 and pdp-deck-m-js-full.png y2380-3080 — the ens-pdp-print figure is byte-for-byte the same stone-path frame with the same "שביל אבן / צילום: Corey Leopold (CC BY 2.0)" on both. So the counts hold. But: (1) The sun tile's universality is a RECORDED RULING, not a slip. SPEC.md §1 R7: "In ens_pdp_weather the sun tile is the white wall in noon sun (CC0) on EVERY product; only the rain tile is gated (solar → rain on a panel; everything else → drops on a stem)" — the stated reason being the designer's objection that on the flagship solar page a gated sun tile makes the pair "two solar panels side by side, cold blue twice". The deployed render is exactly that rule executed. The proposed fix ("rotate at least the sun tile per family") re-opens R7 and never addresses its reasoning. R6 also records the owner's related objection verbatim — "the identical bougainvillea wall appears three times on ONE page" — which is why the built section prints it once per page, not three times. (2) The print duplication is the finding's own stated tolerance. It concedes "one shared photo per family is fine". Deck IS the path family, and not by accident: theme/snippets/elmsnest-s-place.liquid maps the collection תאורת-שביל-סולארית → word "שביל" (lines 32-33, 49-50), verify.json shows placeOrder ["path","path"] and the ROUND-2 scene copy on deck already reads "בלילה, על השביל — אור נמוך, קרוב לאדמה, שמלווה את הדרך", identical to path. SPEC §3 keys the print asset to that place word (4 words → 4 assets), so 4 distinct print photos are drawn across 5 pages; the only repeat is inside one family. (3) "Set its family to something other than path" is outside this round's contract: family comes from the round-2 place snippet, which R9 freezes ("keep the round-2 sections untouched") and which also drives the scene copy and the collection nav; BRIEF §4 restricts this round's edits to the two new sections plus templates/product.elmsnest.json only, and specifies "family by elmsnest-s-place emit:'word' … optional per-family variants" — per-family variation is optional by contract, and the built section does vary the one tile the rule gates. (4) One evidence item is simply wrong: "The weather section text is byte-identical on all five" is false — verify.json pdpSections text for pdp-wall reads "טיפות על גבעול, אחרי הגשם / צילום: jenny downing (CC BY 2.0)" against "טיפות גשם על פאנל סולארי / צילום: h080 (CC BY-SA 2.0)" on the other four. findings.title: The facts list is printed twice — once open, once verbatim inside the accordion
findings.evidence: pdp-path-m-js-full.png, ens-pdp-facts (≈y2260–2980) shows seven rows: גוף נירוסטה / גוון אור צהוב חם / ממוצעת כ־6 שעות / כ־8–10 שעות / IP65 / נעיצה באדמה כ־5–10 ס״מ / מצב ON וטעינה של לפחות 3 שעות. Opening "כל מה שכתוב על המוצר" in mirrors/pdp-path/index.html reveals a block headed "פרטים שכדאי לדעת" with exactly the same seven items in the same order. The same supplier copy also repeats the dusk block ("היא נטענת ביום, נדלקת לבד בלילה") which is already the whole content of ens-pdp-dusk.
findings.fix: Strip the "פרטים שכדאי לדעת" block and the charge/auto-on sentences out of the imported description before it goes into the accordion — the accordion should only hold what is NOT already on the page.

vote.why:
The duplication is real but it is (a) not "printed twice" on the rendered page, and (b) the deliberate, recorded design of a section this round was explicitly ordered not to touch.

WHAT I MEASURED

1. The render. Cropped pdp-path-m-js-full.png (390×4973) at y2230–2990 — the ens_pdp_facts band (verify.json section heights: header 60 + main-product 1085 + scene 596 + dusk 152 + weather 348 = 2241 start, h 723 → ends 2964, matching the evidence's y2260–2980). The band shows exactly one printing of the facts: outlined «IP65» + caption «עמידות», then six hairline rows (חומר הגוף / צבע האור / טעינה / זמן עבודה / התקנה / לפני שימוש ראשון), then ONE 48 px summary row «כל מה שכתוב על המוצר» with a down chevron. Nothing is duplicated in the deployed pixels.

2. The markup. In mirrors/pdp-path/index.html the block is `<details class="ens-facts__more">` with NO `open` attribute (theme/sections/elmsnest-s-pdp-facts.liquid:300-304). The facts section is 723 px tall — the merchant's whole «elms-sales» card is thousands of px, so it is measurably collapsed. The critique's own wording concedes this ("Opening … reveals"), which contradicts its title "printed twice — once open, once verbatim inside the accordion".

3. The claimed identity is slightly off anyway. The dl order is IP65 → body → colour → charge → runtime → install → first-use; the description's list order is body → colour → charge → runtime → IP65 → install → first-use. The dusk sentence is not repeated verbatim either: ens-pdp-dusk prints «ביום הפאנל אוסף שמש, וזה מה שמאיר בלילה. יותר שמש ביום, יותר אור בלילה.» (verify.json pdpSections), not «היא נטענת ביום, נדלקת לבד בלילה» — same subject, different copy, and the second one is inside the closed accordion.

WHY IT IS OUT OF SCOPE / ALREADY DECIDED

4. pdp3/SPEC.md §1 R9 rules verbatim: "Keep the round-2 sections untouched (ens_pdp_scene, ens_pdp_dusk, ens_pdp_facts) … add no second button, price, link or claim." This round built only ens_pdp_weather and ens_pdp_print. The finding re-opens a section the contract fences off.

5. The accordion's content is a recorded simplify-round ruling, not an oversight. simplify/SPEC.md §8.2 item 2 specifies the section as `…<details><summary>כל מה שכתוב על המוצר</summary>{{ product.description }}</details>`, i.e. the merchant's description shown WHOLE. §11 line 355 records the carve-out in so many words: "except inside the merchant's own description, which elmsnest-s-pdp-facts shows verbatim behind `<details>` by design (measured separately as rangesInRawDescription)" — and verify.json duly reports rangesInRawDescription: 3, rangesOutsideBdi: 0. Most decisive, the P2 "answered exactly once" acceptance map (§3) lists the PDP's answer to "Specs / IP?" as a single cell: "facts section (numeral + dl + collapsed description)" — the collapsed description is a designated PART of that one answer, not a second answer.

6. The "nothing twice" principle was already applied here, at the level of visible content. elmsnest-s-pdp-facts.liquid's own header comment: the numeral's caption strips the code token ("«עמידות IP65» gives «עמידות»" — because a giant IP65 over "עמידות IP65" "was the same thing twice"), and the dl "skip[s] any bullet that repeats the variant picker's option values (owner 1, P2)". The dl is *parsed out of* the «פרטים שכדאי לדעת» list (line 15: `split: head_mark | last`) — the two are the same source by construction; that is the section's mechanism, not a bug.

7. The proposed fix is worse than the defect. Stripping the specs block and the charge sentences out of `product.description` means either (i) regex surgery on the merchant's HTML inside the theme, which breaks the summary's own promise — «כל מה שכתוב על המוצר» = "everything written about the product" — turning a truthful label into a false one under BRIEF §3 honesty rules; or (ii) editing product copy in Shopify Admin, an owner content action of the class simplify/SPEC §9 records, outside theme code entirely.

The one thing the finding gets right — that the seven facts also exist inside the supplier text — is true, known, and by design; it costs zero pixels on the page as shipped.
vote.scope: Out of this round's contract (pdp3/SPEC.md §1 R9 keeps ens_pdp_facts untouched) and re-opens a recorded simplify-round ruling (simplify/SPEC.md §8.2 item 2, §3 question map, §11 line 355) whose reasoning the finding does not show to be factually wrong; the render claim itself is also overstated — the accordion is collapsed, so nothing prints twice.

(a) Deleting the section reverses R1 — the owner's own named winner ("exactly what I asked for", owner 8) and the shopper judge's own 8 ("the only copy that answers, in one read and in my own weather") — and reverses the round's mandate (BRIEF §0: more content, two-three image sections). vote.why:
The credits exist on the page — that part is right — but the finding overstates them, and the fix it proposes is barred by the round's own written contract.

WHAT I MEASURED
1. Position and text are real. `pdp-path-m-js-full.png` is 390×4973; cropping y 2020–2360 shows «צילום: h080 (CC BY-SA 2.0)» as the second, muted 12 px line under the rain tile's caption, at y≈2197 — the finding's y≈2190 is accurate. `verify.json['pdp-path-m-js'].pdpCopy.credits` = ["צילום: h080 (CC BY-SA 2.0)", "צילום: Corey Leopold (CC BY 2.0)"].
2. "verify.json pdpCopy.credits lists two per page" is false for one of the five. `pdp-flood-m-js.pdpCopy.credits` has exactly ONE entry (h080); its print section text is «האור האחרון של היום. גן קקטוסים, בשקיעה» with no credit at all, because the גינה slot's photograph is public domain (`elmsnest-s-pdp-print.liquid` L63-67: `assign ens_credit = ''`; schema L265 info «התצלום נחלת הכלל ואינו חייב קרדיט»). So "a second credit under every print" is wrong on 1/5 pages.
3. The credit-name list is scrambled. `jenny downing` is a WEATHER rain-stem credit on pdp-wall (the mains page, where the h080 panel tile is gated out — `verify.json` pdp-wall weather text: «טיפות על גבעול, אחרי הגשם צילום: jenny downing (CC BY 2.0)»), not a print credit. Print credits are Corey Leopold (path, deck), tillwe (rope), BPPrice (wall), none (flood).
4. Prominence. Weather credit: 12 px, `#8f8b83`, on the night ground, and only on ONE of the two tiles — the sun tile is CC0 and carries no credit (weather.liquid `credit_sun` default empty), so the pair reads as caption+caption, not as a credit block. Print credit: 11 px `#6b6558` on the cream mat, `padding-block-start:3px` under the 11 px caption at the mat's foot (print.liquid L210-211, L235-236) — measured 4.71:1, the plate line of a print, subordinate in size and colour to everything around it. Total per page: 2 lines of ~11-12 px muted text in a 5.3-5.9 screen page.

WHY THE FIX IS OUT OF SCOPE
- `pdp3/BRIEF.md` §4, verbatim and binding: «CC BY / CC BY-SA photographs carry a credit («צילום: Name (CC BY 2.0)») as an 11–12 px muted caption **inside the section** — never omitted; CC0/PDM need none.» The proposal ("drop the credit line from the visible surface") asks for the one thing the round's constraint names as never permitted. §6 makes it a judging criterion: the honesty guardian judges «licence + credit on every internet photograph». All five competing concepts drew the credits inside their sections (concepts/{works,weather,pair,install,daylight}/IMAGES.md), so every judge score in §1's ruling table — including shopper 8 on the weather section — was cast on a page with these credit lines drawn.
- The fix also asks for a new `/pages/credits` and a footer edit. `pdp3/BRIEF.md` §4 Files: «the template edit = `templates/product.elmsnest.json` only… no product, collection, page or metafield changed». Creating a page and editing the footer is outside this round's file surface entirely.
- SPEC §2 and §3 specify the credit as part of each section's device («a 12 px muted caption + credit», «the caption naming the place and the credit at the mat's foot»); weather.liquid L72-74 makes it deliberately un-removable while the theme asset is in use («the licence follows the file: while the theme asset is in use its credit cannot be emptied»). It is already an owner `text` setting that empties itself when the owner swaps in his own frame — the escape hatch the finding wants already exists, keyed to the honest condition.

WHY THE REASONING IS ALSO BACKWARDS
The finding's stated harm is that the credits "undercut the impression that the store has ever seen its own product outdoors". These photographs are not of the product and never claim to be — SPEC R1/R7 put materials (rain on a panel, a white wall in noon sun) and R3 puts a named place on a mat there precisely so nothing implies the product; the store's own product frame is the separate `ens_pdp_scene` night photograph. BRIEF §3 is «כאשר מידע אינו מאומת, איננו צריכים להציג אותו כעובדה» — manufacturing the impression that a borrowed golden-hour photograph is the store's own is the dishonesty the whole brief is built to prevent. SPEC §6.2 already records the real remedy as an owner item: the owner's own dusk photograph replaces any of these in one picker, and the credit setting empties with it.

Not refuted: nothing here disputes that a shopper could find two small credit lines slightly odd. But the evidence is inflated (flood has one, not two; one named credit belongs to a different section), the render is far more subordinate than "printed in the middle of a shopping page" suggests, and the proposed fix contradicts a verbatim, never-omitted constraint plus the round's file rule.
vote.scope: Out of this round's contract, and factually overstated. pdp3/BRIEF.md §4 requires the credit as an 11-12 px muted caption inside the section, "never omitted", and bars creating pages or editing anything but templates/product.elmsnest.json; SPEC §2/§3 build the credit into both section devices. Measured in verify.json and the deployed shots: 2 credit lines on 4 pages, 1 on pdp-flood (its print photograph is public domain), at 11-12 px muted, and the finding misassigns jenny downing (a pdp-wall weather credit) to the print set.

vote.why:
Three independent refutations.

1) The measurement is wrong by ~2x, and the band is too short to be a row. I scanned every full-width hairline row in all five mobile full-page shots (/home/user/ElmsNest/brief/side-pages/pdp3/verify/pdp-*-m-js-full.png), flagging rows where >300 of 390 columns differ from the page ground by a small delta. In pdp-rope-m-js-full.png the rules in the facts block are at y=2631, 2703, 2732 — the gap between the last two is **29 px**, not «~55px». In pdp-path-m-js-full.png the spec rules are y=2424, 2496, 2569, 2641, 2713, 2786, 2858, then 2887 — again a **29 px** gap, not ~55. Same 29 px on the other three: deck 2336/2365, wall 2710/2739, flood 2402/2431. The real spec-row pitch on those same pages is **72-73 px** (2424→2496→2569→2641…). A 29 px band cannot be a rendered row: an empty row would be border + padding-block 12px + an empty dd line-box + 12px ≈ 48-72 px and would sit on the row pitch. 29 px is exactly the CSS: `.ens-facts__dl{border-block-end:1px solid #1f1e1d}` (the table's closing rule) + `.ens-facts__more{margin-block-start:28px;border-block-start:1px solid #1f1e1d}` (the disclosure's opening rule). It is a deliberate 28 px separator between the spec table and «כל מה שכתוב על המוצר», not a failed row.

2) The proposed fix is already implemented. /home/user/ElmsNest/theme/sections/elmsnest-s-pdp-facts.liquid line 138-140 does `if val == '' \n continue \n endif` **before** the row is ever appended to `rows` (line 186), and the render loop guards again at line 268 `{%- if f.size < 2 -%}{%- continue -%}`. The whole `<dl>` is itself gated by `{%- if row_list.size > 1 -%}` (line 264). A blank-valued row is structurally impossible to emit, so there is nothing to skip and no divider to suppress — the wrapper is never emitted first.

3) Not this round's surface, and not a regression. SPEC.md §1 R9 rules «Keep the round-2 sections untouched (ens_pdp_scene, ens_pdp_dusk, ens_pdp_facts)». The round-2 comparison shot /home/user/ElmsNest/brief/side-pages/pdp2/verify-after/pdp-path-m-js-full.png shows the identical structure — spec rules at 2076…2438, 2510 (dl end), 2539 (more) — the same 29 px separator. The only defensible residue is a taste question — whether two hairlines 29 px apart is the right way to part the table from the disclosure — but the finding as written ("empty spec row", "~55px", "reads as a spec that failed to load", fix = skip blank rows) misreads the render, misstates the measurement, and asks for code that is already there.

The finding's strings are all real, but its load-bearing claim — «It is the one caption on the five pages that says more than the frame proves» — is factually false, and I measured that in the finding's own evidence file.

What I checked. (1) theme/sections/elmsnest-s-pdp-weather.liquid:348 does carry default «טיפות על גבעול, אחרי הגשם», mirrored at SPEC.md:57. (2) I decoded theme/assets/ens-pdp-rain-stem.jpg (1600×1067) and looked at it: a backlit macro of a plant sprig and a pink flower spike beaded with water, one large hanging drop — no rain, no wet ground, nothing that dates the water. (3) I cropped brief/side-pages/pdp3/verify/pdp-wall-m-js-full.png (390×4826) at y 2050–2300 and read the rendered tile: caption «טיפות על גבעול, אחרי הגשם» over «צילום: jenny downing (CC BY 2.0)». (4) manifest.jsonl:103 titles it «evanescence»; SHORTLIST.md:17 files it «dew/rain drops». So the frame-vs-caption observation is accurate as far as it goes.

Why it does not stand. I dumped ens-pdp-weather text for all 30 rows of verify/verify.json. The stem caption prints on pdp-wall only. The other four pages (path, rope, deck, flood) print «טיפות גשם על פאנל סולארי» — literally «RAIN drops on a solar panel» (elmsnest-s-pdp-weather.liquid:342). That photograph is manifest.jsonl:2, ov_dbe4a3f1, whose own Flickr title is «solar panel close up» from the query «solar panel close up sun» — nothing in it dates that water either; it could be dew, hose or sprinkler exactly as on the stem. The critique clears that caption by paraphrasing it as «rain-panel = drops on a solar panel», silently dropping the word «גשם» that carries the very assertion it is prosecuting on the wall page. So on the finding's own standard the alleged violation appears on 5/5 pages, four of them via a caption the finding certifies; and the proposed one-line fix to cap_rain_plain would leave it standing on 4/5 pages, including the flagship solar path light. A rule that fires once out of five identical instances, and whose fix cures the rarest one, is not the rule the page is breaking.

The standard itself is also over-applied. BRIEF §3's «כאשר מידע אינו מאומת…» sits in a non-negotiables list that is entirely about commerce claims — no best-seller labels, review counts, customer quotes, «trusted by N», no fake urgency, «not for» lines compressed from published guidance, consumer-protection terms findable. pdp3 BRIEF §4 states the binding photo rule: «a caption or heading names what it is (a place, a mechanism, a material)» and the copy rule «claim-free (no hours, lumens, IP, «best», reviews, counts, urgency)». «טיפות על גבעול» names the material; «אחרי הגשם» is atmosphere in the register of the line directly above it («גשם של ינואר.»), and it makes no assertion about the product, the store, or anything a shopper could rely on — a point the finding itself concedes when it stops short of blocker. Nothing on the page presents the photograph as the product or as an Israeli place.

Scope note, secondary: SPEC §1 R1 builds this section on the honesty judge's own reading of it as «exemplary… materials, never places with someone else's lamps», with the §2 copy table recording this exact default; the caption was reviewed, not overlooked. That alone would not close the finding — the ruling does not reason about this phrase specifically — but combined with the measured inconsistency above it leaves nothing to act on at «should» severity.

If anything survives here it is a much smaller, differently-shaped item: the section attributes a provenance to water in two captions rather than one, and if the store wants the strict reading it should drop «גשם»/«אחרי הגשם» from both (cap_rain_solar → «טיפות על פאנל סולארי», cap_rain_plain → «טיפות מים על גבעול»). As filed, the finding is wrong about the render's scope and its fix is incomplete.

vote.why: The render is exactly as described, but the fix is wrong and would make it worse. Measured in pdp-wall-m-js-full.png (390x4826): tile columns are x 20-188 and 201-369, i.e. 169 px each (claim correct). Right tile: y2147-2158 line, y2178-2188 caption (138 px), y2196-2204 «צילום:» alone (ink 340-369 = 30 px), y2212-2225 «jenny downing (CC BY 2.0)» (ink 228-369 = 142 px). 30 + ~4 + 142 = 176 > 169, so the space outside the bdi is the only break opportunity — the diagnosed cause is right, and the 18 px delta between the wall weather section (366) and the path one (348) is that third line. pdp-path-m-js-full.png y~2196-2210 confirms «צילום: h080 (CC BY-SA 2.0)» fits on one line, and pdp-wall-d-js-full.png y~2200 is one line at 1366. Measured the exact shot the evidence names and the finding fails on every measurable clause, and its proposed fix is mostly inert.

1. TILE BOUNDS. In /home/user/ElmsNest/brief/side-pages/pdp3/verify/pdp-path-m-js-full.png (390×4973) I located the pair by scanning against the night ground (8,13,24): two 169 px tiles, left x=20..188, right x=201..369, y=1962..2130 — the evidence's y≈1960-2135 is right, and left = sun (RTL puts the second grid item on the left).

2. "DOMINATED BY A SATURATED YELLOW FAÇADE" IS FALSE. Classifying all 28,561 pixels of the left tile by HLS: yellow (S>0.35, hue 35-70°, L>0.35) = 15.0%. It is the FOURTH largest block, behind warm gravel/ground 22.3%, red bougainvillea 22.6% and shadow/other 23.4%. White wall 8.7% + blue sky 8.0%.

3. "WHITE WALL AND SKY SURVIVE ONLY AT THE FAR EDGE" IS FALSE. The white wall and sky own the entire left third of the frame with literally zero yellow in it; yellow only starts in band 2 and peaks at 32% in the far-right band.  - Mobile 1:1 on a 4:3 file crops HORIZONTALLY only — vertical overflow is 0 px, so the proposed «55%» vertical does nothing at all.
 - Desktop 3:2 on a 4:3 file crops VERTICALLY only — horizontal overflow is 0 px, so the proposed «30%» horizontal does nothing, and the «50%» vertical is already the rendered value. op_sun_desktop 30% 50% is a literal no-op; the full width of the file (white wall and sky included) is already shown at 1366 regardless of that setting.
 - The one live number, mobile 50%→25%, shifts the source window by 0.25×300 = 75 px of 1200 (≈14 of 169 rendered px). I re-rendered both windows from theme/assets/ens-pdp-sun-wall.jpg with the same classifier (it reproduces the deployed tile exactly, Y=15.0%): at 25% yellow goes 15.0%→11.7%, white 10.7→11.9, sky 7.6→9.6. A 3.3-point change is not "the yellow block recedes to the edge."

5. "LOUDEST COLOUR BLOCK ON THE NIGHT PAGE" IS FALSE. Mean saturation×lightness over 169 px bands down the full shot: sun tile 0.154; the ens_related thumbnail grid at y≈3440 scores 0.411 and y≈3760 0.310; the cream print mat 0.237; the scene photo 0.197. Rain tile 0.025.

6. "TWO SECTIONS ABOVE THE AMBER IP NUMERAL" IS FALSE. verify.json pdp-path-m-js.sections orders ens_pdp_weather (348) immediately before ens_pdp_facts (723) — one section, and SPEC §4 says so by design ("the weather pair sits directly above the facts"). The buy button is in main-product, three sections and ~1,100 px up the page.

7. The crop values are the contract, not a slip: SPEC §2's image table specifies sun = 50% 50% phone / 55% 50% desktop, which is exactly what lines 88-89 emit and what the shot shows. R7 rules this CC0 white-wall frame into the sun slot on every product; R6 already heard and disposed of the "loud manila-yellow competes with the amber buy button" objection (it rejected the daylight card, not this frame). Re-litigating the yellow's loudness needs the ruling's reasoning shown factually wrong, and the measurements go the other way.

vote.why: The finding's candidate selection is arithmetically wrong. From the deployed mirror (brief/side-pages/pdp3/verify/mirrors/pdp-path/index.html) the weather tiles carry sizes="(min-width:1348px) 610px, (min-width:901px) calc(46vw - 10px), (min-width:501px) calc(46vw - 6px), calc(50vw - 26px)" and ladders 400w,600w,900w,1066w (rain panel) / 400w,600w,900w,1200w (sun wall); the print carries calc(100vw - 68px) with 400w,700w,1000w,1200w. At 390 CSS px the tile is 169 px (the critique's own number), so a DPR-2 phone needs 338 device px and takes the 400w rung, not 600w — a browser picks the smallest candidate >= the required width and never up-selects. vote.why:
Both halves of the evidence are wrong on the file the finding cites.

(1) The lazy counter is not broken and does not "read 0 forever". `verify-mirror.js` line ~206, inside the JS branch of the render loop, deliberately flips every image before the audit: `if (js) { await page.evaluate(async () => { document.querySelectorAll('img[loading="lazy"]').forEach(i => i.loading = 'eager'); for (let y = 0; ...) window.scrollTo(0, y) ... }) }` — the harness forces lazy→eager and scrolls the page so that the `loaded` counter and the full-page screenshot are meaningful. Deleting or "repairing" it would destroy a working probe.

(2) `credits: sec.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/products/"]').length` is not a mis-named product-link counter — it is the exact selector for the credit it was written for. pdp2/SPEC.md §II (lines 69-70, 121) defines the scene section's credit as «בתמונה: {pictured product's title}» **linked to that product** (the `scene_fallback` collection-scene credit). (3) The round-3 CC credits are already asserted verbatim, as the finding concedes: `pdpCopy.credits` per page returns exactly the credit strings drawn — path ["צילום: h080 (CC BY-SA 2.0)", "צילום: Corey Leopold (CC BY 2.0)"], wall ["jenny downing", "BPPrice"], rope ["h080", "tillwe"], flood ["h080"] — plus `printCap` («שביל אבן», «גן קקטוסים, בשקיעה»…). findings.title: `white-space:nowrap` on the credit isolate can push text out of a 169 px tile, and already orphans «צילום:»
findings.evidence: theme/sections/elmsnest-s-pdp-weather.liquid:214 — `.ens-pdp-weather__credit bdi{white-space:nowrap}` — inside a grid track that is only (350-12)/2 = 169 px at 390, with no `overflow-wrap`, no clipping, and `min-inline-size:0` on the tile (line 205) so the track will not grow. findings.fix: In theme/sections/elmsnest-s-pdp-weather.liquid replace line 214 with `.ens-pdp-weather__credit bdi{overflow-wrap:anywhere}` and add `overflow-wrap:anywhere` to the `.ens-pdp-weather__cap` rule on line 213. P6 only requires the Latin run to sit in one `<bdi dir="ltr">` isolate; letting that isolate wrap keeps the isolation and removes both the widow and the overflow risk.

vote.why:
The measurements in the finding are real, but the consequence and the fix are not.

What I verified (all of it holds): `/home/user/ElmsNest/theme/sections/elmsnest-s-pdp-weather.liquid:214` is `.ens-pdp-weather__credit bdi{white-space:nowrap}`; the tile is `min-inline-size:0` (l.205) inside `repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))` with a 12 px gap (l.204), and `--env2-gut:clamp(20px,4vw,64px)` (elmsnest-v2-core.liquid:21) gives a 350 px wrap at 390, so the track really is 169 px and really cannot grow. Cropping `pdp-wall-m-js-full.png` (390x4826) and profiling non-background pixels: the wrap band runs x20-369; the rain tile's caption is «טיפות על גבעול, אחרי הגשם» (y2180-2188), then «צילום:» alone at y2198-2204 spanning x340-369 (30 px), then the isolate «jenny downing (CC BY 2.0)» at y2214-2225 spanning x229-369 = 141 px inside the 201-370 track — 28 px of headroom. The widow is real and the arithmetic is right. verify.json corroborates it: `ens-pdp-weather` is 366 px on wall vs 348 on rope, one 12x1.5 = 18 px line more.

Why it still fails as a «should»:

1. The overflow consequence is wrong for the tile that carries a credit. In RTL the first grid column is the RIGHT one: the rain tile is x201-370. An over-long unbreakable inline in an RTL block overflows toward inline-end = LEFT, i.e. into the 12 px gap and the page interior — not toward a document edge. It would need ~200 px of overflow (2.4x the present 141 px string, ~60 Latin characters) before reaching x=0. So `overflowX:false` is not «one credit string away from flipping» from this credit. The only tile whose overflow runs at the page edge is the sun tile (x20-189), and that slot ships with NO credit at all — `credit_sun` default is empty and its schema `info` says «התצלום הוא CC0 ואינו חייב קרדיט» (SPEC §2 table, l.61). Flipping overflowX needs an owner to type >189 px (~33 chars) of Latin into a field the page tells him not to fill.

2. Nothing overflows at any contracted width. The contract's widths are 390, 360 and 1366 (SPEC §5 / the verify set). At 360 the gutter is still 20 px, wrap 320, track 154 px — the longest shipped credit is 141 px, so it fits; at 1366 the track is ~590 px. All five pages ship fixed credits from CHOSEN.md (h080, jenny downing, BPPrice, tillwe), the longest of which is the one measured. The 18 px the wrap costs is inside the budget (366 ≤ 430, SPEC §5). The present-tense defect is therefore only a 12 px `#8f8b83` widow in a muted caption — and the sun tile's own caption wraps to two lines in the same shot, so a two-line caption is the section's normal texture, not a break.

3. The proposed fix contradicts this section's own recorded rule. SPEC §2 (l.39) and the section's comments (l.26, l.148) put the whole Latin tail in ONE `<bdi dir="ltr">` precisely «so «(CC BY-SA 2.0)» never breaks up»; `nowrap` is the CSS that enforces it. `overflow-wrap:anywhere` on that bdi restores soft-wrap opportunities at the spaces, so «jenny downing (CC BY 2.0)» becomes «…(CC BY» / «2.0)» — the licence code split across two lines in an RTL column, which is a worse outcome than the «צילום:» widow it removes. Adding `overflow-wrap:anywhere` to `.ens-pdp-weather__cap` also licenses mid-word breaks in the Hebrew captions for no demonstrated need. A fix that traded the widow without breaking the licence token (e.g. a non-breaking space after «צילום:», or letting the prefix and isolate share one line) is not what was proposed.

So: the render is measured correctly, the failure mode is not, the fix regresses a stated contract, and what remains is a nit rather than a «should».
vote.scope: In scope (the deployed ens_pdp_weather render; not a ruling SPEC §1 rejected), but overstated in severity and wrong in consequence. The single verifiable fact — «צילום:» widowed above a 141 px isolate in a 169 px track on pdp-wall at 390 — is a cosmetic nit inside the height budget; the overflow scenario requires owner-typed text in the one credit slot the schema says needs none, and would not reach a page edge from the credited (right-hand) tile.

findings.title: An owner who swaps a photograph keeps the previous photographer's credit under it
findings.evidence: elmsnest-s-pdp-weather.liquid:72-75 and 84-87 only force the asset's credit when `ens_pic == blank and ens_cred == blank`; elmsnest-s-pdp-print.liquid:50-55 (and the three parallel branches) likewise fall through to `section.settings.credit_*`, whose schema defaults are the flickr credits (print lines 257, 261, 269; weather lines 341, 347). A code-side belt: when `ens_pic != blank` and the credit still equals the shipped asset's credit string, blank it rather than print it.

vote.why:
Measured, not argued.

1) Nothing the store publishes is misattributed. I pulled every credit string out of /home/user/ElmsNest/brief/side-pages/pdp3/verify/verify.json (30 screen records: 5 products x m/s/d x js/nojs). Every drawn credit matches the file actually shown, against images/CHOSEN.md: rain-panel = «צילום: h080 (CC BY-SA 2.0)» on the four solar pages, rain-stem = «צילום: jenny downing (CC BY 2.0)» on the MAINS wall page, print-path = Corey Leopold on path/deck, print-balcony = tillwe on rope, print-wall = BPPrice on wall, sun-wall (CC0) with no credit line, flood text-only print gate closed. Zero mismatches. The finding names no defect in the deployed page; it names a hypothetical future owner edit.

2) The evidence misreads the print section, and the misread inverts the design. It says print:50-55 "likewise falls through to section.settings.credit_*". It does not: each of the four branches has a dedicated `if ens_pic != blank / elsif ens_credit == blank` fork (lines 50-55, 63-68, 76-81, 89-94), and the weather guard it quotes (`ens_pic == blank and ens_cred == blank`, lines 72-75 / 84-87) is the same shape with the comment that states the intent verbatim: "the licence follows the file: while the theme asset is in use its credit cannot be emptied". The force applies ONLY while the shipped asset is in use. The moment the owner picks their own photograph, the credit field is entirely theirs — clearing it prints no credit at all (the render is gated on `ens_credit_html != ''`, print:236). The lever the finding asks for already exists and is the whole point of that fork.

3) That fork is one commit old and was written by a previous lens pass on this exact code. `git show effbe52` ("credits bound to the file") replaced `section.settings.credit_path | default: 'צילום: Corey Leopold…'` — which really did print the shipped credit under an owner's own swapped photograph and could not be emptied — with the current guard. The proposed "code-side belt" (blank the credit when ens_pic != blank and it still equals the shipped string) re-opens that decision in the opposite direction and is the worse of the two: it silently drops attribution, which is the actual BRIEF §4 violation ("never omitted"), including when an owner legitimately re-uploads the same licensed frame.

4) Line numbers are partly wrong: the weather credit defaults are at 343 and 349, not 341 and 347 (355 and the print 257/261/265/269 are correct).

5) A credit-only warning would not be the fix even on its own terms. The identical staleness applies to `cap_path` ("שביל אבן"), `cap_rain_solar`, and the alt text — a swapped photograph makes the caption lie too. And the pattern (image_picker with the theme asset as the empty default, text settings whose defaults describe that asset) is what BRIEF §4 itself prescribes — "image slots as settings (image_picker with a theme asset as the empty default)" — and is theme-wide: elmsnest-s-page.liquid ships the same cred_* defaults (e.g. line 768) next to its own pickers.

Conceded: the owner-error mode is real, and one clause added to the credit `info` strings would be cheap and harmless. But as a finding against the deployed product page it fails on all three tests — the pages are correct, the mechanism it says is missing is present, and its code fix would undo a deliberate, one-commit-old ruling in the direction that breaks §4.

(2) The finding's implied reading ("260 KB = transferred image bytes at whatever density the visitor has") is internally inconsistent with the finding itself. The weather `sizes` resolves to 610 px and the print `sizes` to 620 px at ≥1348 px, so at 1366×900 DPR-1 — a viewport verify-mirror.js DOES shoot (`pdp-path-d-js-full.png`, VIEWS entry ['d',1366,900]) — the page fetches 231,496+204,150+104,980 = 528 KB, twice the line, with no DPR trick at all. If the line meant bytes-at-any-density it was already blown at a tested view and the finding would be "the budget fails on desktop", not "it was never tested at DPR-3". The only self-consistent reading of the line is the 390 phone §5 is built on, and there it passes.

(3) The proposed fix is refuted by the same measurements. Dropping the weather `ens_want` to '400,600,900' (elmsnest-s-pdp-weather.liquid:263) changes nothing at DPR-3 mobile — the tile is 169 CSS px, needs 507 device px, and already picks 600w whether or not 1200/1600 are listed. Where it does bite (desktop 2×) it makes things WORSE, because CDN bytes do not scale with width here: rain-panel 900w = 231,496 B is bigger than its 1066w = 193,222 B, and sun-wall 900w = 204,150 B is bigger than its 1200w = 200,926 B (the source JPEGs are aggressive q62/q66, so the CDN re-encode at 900 is heavier than the near-native rendition). And it leaves the print image untouched, which is the single largest DPR-3 contributor (198,886 B of the 402,468 B / 393 KB a DPR-3 path page would fetch; on the MAINS page pdp-wall the same sum is 51,271+88,568+141,971 = 275 KB).

(4) The contractual rule is BRIEF §4 / pdp3 BRIEF.md:74 — "≤ 3 new photographs per page, lazy, sized, ≤ 220 KB each, asset_img_url candidates ≤ the file" — and it is both met (files 152–197 KB) and actually probed: verify.json records sized 1/1, lazy, loaded, and srcset 400w/600w/900w/1066w · 400w/600w/900w/1200w · 400w/700w/1000w/1200w, all capped at the file width. SPEC §5 enumerates the probes verify-mirror.js must add and a byte counter is not among them; the absence is the spec's stated scope, not a deviation from it.

Minor: the cited line is off — `deviceScaleFactor: 1` is verify-mirror.js:204, not :200 (200 is the loop header).

What survives: adding a DPR-3 byte probe would be a genuine improvement to the harness, and at DPR-3 the flagship path page really would pull ~393 KB. But the finding's own severity is "nit / measurement gap, not a defect in the sections", its remedy is measurably counter-productive, and the budget it says is "unverified" is verifiable from the artifacts this round already shipped and passes at the density §5 is written against.
vote.scope: SPEC §5 budget wording + the shared verify-mirror.js harness — a measurement/convention question, not a defect in elmsnest-s-pdp-weather.liquid or elmsnest-s-pdp-print.liquid; does not re-open any §1 ruling.
